page.overview:
Who is Baby Lich?

The Lich, also known as Baby Lich, is the version of The Lich from the Baby World timeline, who makes his first appearance in "The Winter King".

He greatly resembles his counterpart, though being an infant he is a miniature in size comparison. He wears a moss green muu muu, a miniature version of his crown, his right horn is still missing, his eyes derp in the opposite directions, and he has no teeth and is seemingly drooling.

He first appears in "The Winter King", when Fionna, Cake, and Simon Petrikov visit his universe. He is seen inside a crib, leaning against its bars while the guests go about their business.
